name: list
description: Semantic list (ul/li) for rows of related items: settings, results, nav — with leading/trailing slots, selection, and pressable rows.
designIntent: Row collections are lists, not tables or div stacks: screen readers announce item counts and navigate by item. List/ListItem keep that semantics while providing the layout vocabulary (slots, dividers, density, selection) that real product UIs need — and a pressable row wraps its content in a button so ul > li structure stays valid.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Card-like surface and border around the list (List).

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading slot: icon, avatar, status dot, or checkbox (ListItem).

props.name: trailing
props.description: Trailing slot: chevron, badge, meta, or action (ListItem).

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the row as the active/selected item (ListItem).

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary line under the main content (ListItem); accepts text or rich meta such as badges and dots.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the row pressable — content renders inside a full-width button so list semantics stay intact (ListItem).

examples.title: Settings rows with selection
examples.code:
<List bordered divided>
  <ListItem leading={<Icon />} trailing={<Badge>new</Badge>} selected>
    Notifications
  </ListItem>
  <ListItem leading={<Icon />} description="Weekly digest every Monday">
    Digest
  </ListItem>
</List>
examples.description: selected highlights the active row; description adds a sub-line.

examples.title: Pressable rows
examples.description: onClick renders the row content inside a <button> — keyboard and screen-reader behavior come free.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use a table for non-tabular rows
antiPatterns.explanation: Tables imply column relationships. Rows of independent items are lists — assistive tech announces them as such.

antiPatterns.title: Don't put onClick on the li itself
antiPatterns.explanation: Let ListItem wrap content in a button (which it does automatically) — a click handler on li breaks list semantics for screen readers.

accessibility.implementation: Renders <ul>/<li>; screen readers announce item counts and per-item navigation
accessibility.userRequirements: Use ListItem for every row — arbitrary children break the list contract

accessibility.implementation: onClick rows wrap content in a full-width <button> with focus ring and disabled support
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide an accessible name via the row's text content

accessibility.implementation: selected uses aria-current-less styling; add aria-current on the row via props when it marks location
accessibility.userRequirements: Pass aria-current="true" for navigation lists where the row IS the current location

compositionRules.relationship: Wrap a List in a Block section for titled groups
